tools.name: consult_authority_and_search_flywheels
tools.description:
Consult the Authority Link & Organic Search Flywheel frameworks.
    Covers: Authority link building (v1 & v2), reverse outreach, editorial link magnets, zero-click search strategy, and digital PR.

tools.name: consult_category_positioning_and_permission_marketing
tools.description:
Consult the Category Positioning & Permission Marketing frameworks.
    Covers: remarkable differentiation, the smallest viable market, permission asset accumulation, tribe building, and brand positioning.

tools.name: consult_conversion_funnels_and_lead_magnets
tools.description:
Consult the Customer Value Journey & Direct-Response Funnel frameworks.
    Covers: 8-stage customer journey, tripwires, lead magnets, ascension loops, value ladders, and webinar conversion funnels.

tools.name: consult_growth_council_roundtable
tools.description:
Convenes the full multi-discipline Growth Council for end-to-end strategic review.
    Retrieves synthesized viewpoints across Acquisition, Funnels, Conversion, Distribution, and Positioning.

tools.name: consult_heuristic_cro_and_growth_experiments
tools.description:
Consult the Empirical CRO & High-Tempo Growth frameworks.
    Covers: Heuristic CRO audits, qualitative/quantitative user research, friction reduction, North Star Metric, PMF surveys, and ICE prioritization.

tools.name: consult_omnichannel_storytelling_and_distribution
tools.description:
Consult the Content Pyramid & Human Brand Voice frameworks.
    Covers: Content pyramid (1 pillar -> 64 micro-content pieces), attention economics, human editorial voice, newsletter retention, and storytelling.

tools.name: consult_seo_and_content_architecture
tools.description:
Consult the Technical SEO & Programmatic Scaling frameworks.
    Covers: Technical SEO architecture, URL taxonomy, content decay audits, programmatic directory design, and search intent clustering.

tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: Retrieve full playbook text matching a specific title keyword within a framework.

tools.name: list_disciplines_and_playbooks
tools.description: Lists all 11 growth disciplines, framework IDs, core methodologies, and indexed playbook counts.

tools.name: search_growth_playbooks
tools.description:
Search across 19,000+ battle-tested marketing and growth playbooks.
    
    Args:
        query: The marketing problem, goal, or strategic question (e.g., 'how to structure a high-converting pricing page', 'SaaS programmatic SEO strategy')
        framework_id: Optional filter. Available: seo_architecture, programmatic_seo, skyscraper_authority, audience_flywheel, customer_value_journey, direct_response_funnels, content_pyramid, brand_voice_editorial, heuristic_cro, high_tempo_growth, permission_positioning
        limit: Number of playbooks to retrieve (default: 5, max: 10)
